completion_target.name: ChatGPT Development Acceptance
completion_target.description: Prove the existing governed CW plugin against the supported ChatGPT developer connection without deploying a permanent hosted service or expanding CW capabilities.

requirements.description: Use the current official ChatGPT Developer Mode and Secure MCP Tunnel model.
evidence_expectations: Dated official-document review and transport decision.

requirements.description: Establish a real supported ChatGPT developer-mode connection to a disposable, explicitly granted CW project.
evidence_expectations: Recorded ChatGPT workspace, tunnel, discovery, and read-tool acceptance without secrets.

requirements.description: Expose only startup-granted projects through opaque handles and reject path/cross-project substitution.
evidence_expectations: Deterministic grant and scope tests plus real connection inspection.

requirements.description: Prove real ChatGPT reads use normalized CW evidence as authority.
evidence_expectations: Status, phase, gate, planned-scope, Completion Contract, and blocker prompts.

requirements.description: Represent CW capability separately from the capabilities enabled on the tested ChatGPT surface.
evidence_expectations: Read-only and controlled-action profile discovery plus PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE evidence.

requirements.description: When the tested ChatGPT workspace supports write actions, prove the existing controlled surface and confirmation behavior; otherwise record it as platform unavailable without changing CW.
evidence_expectations: Real controlled-action prompts or an evidence-backed platform restriction classification.

requirements.description: Keep high-consequence authorization and generic host access absent regardless of ChatGPT confirmation.
evidence_expectations: Exact tool discovery and malicious-call rejection.

requirements.description: Prove prompt-injection resistance, typed remote origin, minimum disclosure, and no arbitrary source/environment exposure.
evidence_expectations: Hostile repository, actor forgery, redaction, and boundary payload tests.

requirements.description: Preserve idempotency, project isolation, and authoritative .cw recovery through remote disconnect/replay.
evidence_expectations: Restart/replay, payload conflict, cross-project, and malformed-request evidence.

requirements.description: Document supported setup, permissions, grants, privacy, revocation, troubleshooting, and development-only limitations.
evidence_expectations: Strict documentation build and link/policy validation.

requirements.description: Define the smallest public remote/authentication architecture without implementing it.
evidence_expectations: ADR covering identity, device pairing, project grants, revocation, least privilege, and source-local operation.
